carriers.name: HealthSpring
carriers.scope: 2027 Medicare Advantage · former Cigna Medicare · NC True Choice pilot
carriers.availability: True Choice (PPO) H7849-113-001 imported for its 11 official NC counties. ZIP 28262 includes Mecklenburg and Cabarrus; confirm the county. Other HealthSpring plans/states are not imported.
carriers.benefits: Official 2027 Summary of Benefits and Evidence of Coverage linked; premium, dental, medical maximum, specialist, hospital and vision amounts imported with conditions. OTC and routine transportation amounts remain unverified; routine hearing aids are not covered.

carriers.providers: Official 2027 NC PPO PDF linked to True Choice. Public directory responds on port 8003, but no 2027 InsurancePlan records were found. Manual provider/facility selections export for review; live coverage checks remain unverified.
carriers.connection: Public plan lookup prepared with exact CMS segment and full-year validation. It checks for 2027 records when providers are entered and rejects historical mappings. Current public catalog has 618 records dated 2025/2026. Browser CORS tested; no authentication required for tested requests.
carriers.next_step: Confirm availability of 2027 API plan/network records, then validate exact-office checks. Extend verified documents to the remaining HealthSpring plans and states.
